notes.title: DAROLD THE DOOMER TURNS 3!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42153910/89f3c14db5a963dde4bda90d378e46af9bb850e9.png[/img]

On April 6, 2022, I published Darold the Doomer: Psychedelic Lucid Dreams to Steam. And over these 3 years, I've learned quite a bit about how this 30 minute walking sim is considered to be a "hidden gem". I'm still kind of bewildered by the fact that so many people have enjoyed and even some considering the game to be one of their favorites. I didn't expect this game to get as good of a reception as it did, let alone the amount of high regards it's been given. As for the future of Darold, along with my other project, Mind of the Midwest... I'm not entirely sure what I'll do in the future, any one of these games could be my "last one" but it all sort of boils down to my status on capability as well as creativity. Either way. Thank you all so much for your support, and I hope to witness you all experience Mind of the Midwest when it comes out!

-Janxferz
